description: This file defines a command class for exporting dataset models and related database information in YAML format, including methods for generating filenames, content, and exporting related database details.

classes.name: ExportDatasetsCommand
classes.description: A command class for exporting dataset models and associated database info in YAML format, with methods for filename generation, content creation, and exporting related database details.

methods.name: _file_name
methods.description: Generates the filename for a dataset YAML file based on the database and table name.

methods.name: _file_content
methods.description: Creates YAML content for a dataset model, including decoding JSON fields and adding metadata.

methods.name: _export
methods.description: Yields filename-content pairs for exporting a dataset and optionally its related database information.
